question: okay talk to me about bad recent offboardings?

queries.purpose: Count people whose employment ended in the last 30 days.
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ended_people, MIN(end_date) AS earliest_end, MAX(end_date) AS latest_end FROM people WHERE employment_status = 'ended' AND end_date BETWEEN date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z','-30 days') AND date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z')

queries.purpose: List recent ended workers and summarize active accounts and application access.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.worker_type, p.department, p.end_date, SUM(CASE WHEN i.status='active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_idp_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN aua.status='active' THEN aua.access_id END) AS active_apps, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN w.status='active' THEN w.account_id END) AS active_workspace_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.status='active' THEN g.account_id END) AS active_github_accounts FROM people p LEFT JOIN idp_accounts i ON i.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access aua ON aua.idp_account_id=i.account_id LEFT JOIN workspace_accounts w ON w.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_accounts g ON g.person_id=p.person_id WHERE p.employment_status='ended' AND p.end_date BETWEEN date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z','-30 days') AND date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') GROUP BY p.person_id ORDER BY p.end_date DESC

queries.purpose: Count post-employment audit activity for recent offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) AS post_end_events, MAX(e.occurred_at) AS latest_event FROM people p JOIN (SELECT person_id, account_id FROM idp_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT person_id, account_id FROM workspace_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT person_id, account_id FROM github_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL) a ON a.person_id=p.person_id JOIN audit_events e ON e.actor_type='account' AND e.actor_id=a.account_id AND e.occurred_at >= p.end_date || 'T00:00:00Z' WHERE p.employment_status='ended' AND p.end_date BETWEEN date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z','-30 days') AND date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') GROUP BY p.person_id ORDER BY post_end_events DESC

queries.purpose: Summarize other current access and devices for recent offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gom.revoked_at IS NULL THEN gom.membership_id END) AS github_org_memberships, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gtm.revoked_at IS NULL THEN gtm.membership_id END) AS github_teams, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at>'2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') THEN grc.permission_id END) AS github_direct_repos, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wo.revoked_at IS NULL THEN wo.grant_id END) AS oauth_grants, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.retired_at IS NULL THEN d.device_id END) AS unretired_devices FROM people p LEFT JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id=ga.account_id LEFT JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id=ga.account_id LEFT JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id=ga.account_id LEFT JOIN workspace_accounts wa ON wa.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN workspace_oauth_grants wo ON wo.account_id=wa.account_id LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.person_id=p.person_id WHERE p.employment_status='ended' AND p.end_date BETWEEN date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z','-30 days') AND date('2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') GROUP BY p.person_id ORDER BY p.end_date DESC

queries.purpose: Get account and active application records for the two failed recent offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, i.account_id AS idp_account_id, i.username, i.status AS idp_status, i.last_login_at, u.access_id, a.name AS application_name, a.sensitivity, u.role, u.status AS access_status, u.last_authenticated_at FROM people p JOIN idp_accounts i ON i.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=i.account_id AND u.status='active' LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.application_id=u.application_id WHERE p.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') ORDER BY p.person_id, a.name

queries.purpose: Get Workspace, GitHub, and device records for the two failed recent offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, wa.account_id AS workspace_account_id, wa.status AS workspace_status, wa.last_login_at AS workspace_last_login, ga.account_id AS github_account_id, ga.login, ga.status AS github_status, ga.last_active_at, d.device_id, d.platform, d.ownership, d.compliance_status, d.last_check_in_at, d.retired_at FROM people p LEFT JOIN workspace_accounts wa ON wa.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.person_id=p.person_id AND d.retired_at IS NULL WHERE p.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') ORDER BY p.person_id

queries.purpose: Get current GitHub organization and team membership IDs for the two failed offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, ga.account_id, gom.membership_id AS org_membership_id, gom.org_role, gom.source AS org_source, gtm.membership_id AS team_membership_id, gt.name AS team_name, gtm.role AS team_role, gtm.source AS team_source FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id=ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id=ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN github_teams gt ON gt.team_id=gtm.team_id WHERE p.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') ORDER BY p.person_id, gt.name

queries.purpose: Inspect post-end account activity for the two failed recent offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, e.event_id, e.occurred_at, e.system, e.event_type, e.actor_type, e.actor_id, e.target_type, e.target_id, e.source, e.outcome, e.ip_address, e.details_json FROM people p JOIN (SELECT person_id, account_id FROM idp_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT person_id, account_id FROM workspace_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT person_id, account_id FROM github_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL) a ON a.person_id=p.person_id JOIN audit_events e ON e.actor_type='account' AND e.actor_id=a.account_id AND e.occurred_at >= p.end_date || 'T00:00:00Z' WHERE p.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') ORDER BY e.occurred_at

queries.purpose: Check current direct and inherited Drive access for the two failed offboardings.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, membership_id, depth) AS (SELECT wa.account_id, m.group_id, m.membership_id, 1 FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN workspace_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='account' AND m.member_id=wa.account_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE wa.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') UNION SELECT ag.account_id, m.group_id, m.membership_id, ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN workspace_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10), perms AS (SELECT wa.person_id, wa.account_id, dp.permission_id, dp.principal_type, dr.resource_id, dr.name, dr.classification, dp.role FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN drive_permissions dp ON dp.principal_type='account' AND dp.principal_id=wa.account_id AND dp.revoked_at IS NULL AND (dp.expires_at IS NULL OR dp.expires_at>'2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN drive_resources dr ON dr.resource_id=dp.resource_id WHERE wa.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') UNION SELECT wa.person_id, wa.account_id, dp.permission_id, dp.principal_type, dr.resource_id, dr.name, dr.classification, dp.role FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN account_groups ag ON ag.account_id=wa.account_id JOIN drive_permissions dp ON dp.principal_type='group' AND dp.principal_id=ag.group_id AND dp.revoked_at IS NULL AND (dp.expires_at IS NULL OR dp.expires_at>'2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN drive_resources dr ON dr.resource_id=dp.resource_id WHERE wa.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945')) SELECT * FROM perms ORDER BY person_id, name

queries.purpose: Identify current GitHub repository access for the two failed offboardings.
queries.sql: SELECT p.person_id, ga.account_id, r.repository_id, r.name, r.sensitivity, r.visibility, x.permission_id, x.permission, x.access_path, x.membership_id FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id=p.person_id JOIN (SELECT tm.account_id, trp.repository_id, trp.permission_id, trp.permission, 'team' AS access_path, tm.membership_id FROM github_team_memberships tm JOIN github_team_repo_permissions trp ON trp.team_id=tm.team_id AND trp.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE tm.revoked_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.account_id, c.repository_id, c.permission_id, c.permission, 'direct', NULL FROM github_repo_collaborators c WHERE c.revoked_at IS NULL AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at>'2026-08-15T12:00:00Z')) x ON x.account_id=ga.account_id JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id=x.repository_id WHERE p.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') ORDER BY p.person_id, r.name

queries.purpose: Describe resources accessed after employment ended.
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, e.occurred_at, e.actor_id, e.event_type, e.target_id, COALESCE(dr.name,gr.name) AS target_name, COALESCE(dr.classification,gr.sensitivity) AS target_sensitivity FROM audit_events e LEFT JOIN drive_resources dr ON e.target_type='drive_resource' AND dr.resource_id=e.target_id LEFT JOIN github_repositories gr ON e.target_type='repository' AND gr.repository_id=e.target_id WHERE e.event_id IN ('evt_00014550','evt_00018627','evt_00048004','evt_00048016') ORDER BY e.occurred_at

queries.purpose: Count distinct current Drive resources by classification for each failed offboarding.
queries.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, depth) AS (SELECT wa.account_id,m.group_id,1 FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN workspace_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='account' AND m.member_id=wa.account_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE wa.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') UNION SELECT ag.account_id,m.group_id,ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN workspace_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10), perms AS (SELECT wa.person_id,dr.resource_id,dr.classification FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN drive_permissions dp ON dp.principal_type='account' AND dp.principal_id=wa.account_id AND dp.revoked_at IS NULL AND (dp.expires_at IS NULL OR dp.expires_at>'2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN drive_resources dr ON dr.resource_id=dp.resource_id WHERE wa.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945') UNION SELECT wa.person_id,dr.resource_id,dr.classification FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN account_groups ag ON ag.account_id=wa.account_id JOIN drive_permissions dp ON dp.principal_type='group' AND dp.principal_id=ag.group_id AND dp.revoked_at IS NULL AND (dp.expires_at IS NULL OR dp.expires_at>'2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN drive_resources dr ON dr.resource_id=dp.resource_id WHERE wa.person_id IN ('per_001941','per_001945')) SELECT person_id, classification, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_id) AS resource_count, MIN(resource_id) AS example_resource_id FROM perms GROUP BY person_id,classification ORDER BY person_id,classification

report.summary: Two recent offboardings are seriously incomplete. Rowan Mercer and Ariel Chen retain active core accounts and critical applications, with successful account activity after their employment ended.

findings.title: Rowan retained and used access
findings.statement: Rowan retains active IdP, Workspace, GitHub, and critical app access; post-end activity included a push to production-critical payments-api.

findings.title: Ariel retained and used access
findings.statement: Ariel retains active IdP, Workspace, GitHub, and critical app access; successful post-end IdP login and Drive viewing occurred.

findings.title: Sensitive GitHub access remains
findings.statement: Both people retain team-based private repository access, including production-critical repositories.

findings.title: Restricted Drive access remains
findings.statement: Both people retain group-based Drive access to restricted resources.

findings.title: Company devices remain enrolled
findings.statement: Both retain unretired company Windows devices; Rowan’s device checked in after employment ended.

findings.title: Urgent containment is warranted
findings.statement: Successful account actions after both end dates, combined with broad retained access, indicate offboarding failure rather than harmless stale records.

data_gaps: “Recent” was interpreted as the 30 days through 2026-08-15; audit logs are incomplete and account events do not prove which human acted.
recommended_actions: Immediately suspend Rowan’s and Ariel’s IdP, Workspace, and GitHub accounts and revoke active application sessions.
Remove their GitHub organization and team memberships, then verify repository access is gone.
Remove Workspace group memberships and verify restricted Drive access is gone.
Retire or recover both company devices and investigate their recent check-ins.
Review the post-end repository push, Drive views, login events, source IPs, and related activity.

proposed_tools.name: find_recent_incomplete_offboardings
proposed_tools.description: Find ended people in a date range who retain active core accounts or application access. Returns person, account, and access IDs suitable for evidence.

parameters.name: since_date
parameters.description: Earliest employment end date to include.

parameters.name: snapshot_date
parameters.description: Snapshot calendar date through which end dates are included.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.full_name, p.end_date, i.account_id AS idp_account_id, i.status AS idp_status, w.account_id AS workspace_account_id, w.status AS workspace_status, g.account_id AS github_account_id, g.status AS github_status, u.access_id, u.status AS app_access_status, u.application_id FROM people p LEFT JOIN idp_accounts i ON i.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN workspace_accounts w ON w.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_accounts g ON g.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN application_user_access u ON u.idp_account_id=i.account_id AND u.status='active' WHERE p.employment_status='ended' AND p.end_date BETWEEN :since_date AND :snapshot_date AND (i.status='active' OR w.status='active' OR g.status='active' OR u.access_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.end_date DESC, p.person_id, u.access_id

proposed_tools.name: get_post_end_account_activity
proposed_tools.description: Return audit events attributed to any linked IdP, Workspace, or GitHub account after a person's employment end date.
proposed_tools.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.end_date, a.account_id, e.event_id, e.occurred_at, e.system, e.event_type, e.actor_type, e.actor_id, e.target_type, e.target_id, e.source, e.outcome, e.ip_address, e.details_json FROM people p JOIN (SELECT person_id, account_id FROM idp_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT person_id, account_id FROM workspace_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT person_id, account_id FROM github_accounts WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL) a ON a.person_id=p.person_id JOIN audit_events e ON e.actor_type='account' AND e.actor_id=a.account_id AND e.occurred_at >= p.end_date || 'T00:00:00Z' WHERE p.person_id=:person_id ORDER BY e.occurred_at

proposed_tools.name: get_current_github_access_for_person
proposed_tools.description: Return current organization, team, and repository access for a person, including permission and membership evidence IDs.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Timestamp used to exclude expired direct collaborator grants.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT p.person_id, ga.account_id, gom.membership_id AS org_membership_id, x.membership_id AS team_membership_id, x.permission_id, x.repository_id, r.name AS repository_name, r.sensitivity, x.permission, x.access_path FROM people p JOIN github_accounts ga ON ga.person_id=p.person_id LEFT JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id=ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN (SELECT tm.account_id, tm.membership_id, trp.permission_id, trp.repository_id, trp.permission, 'team' AS access_path FROM github_team_memberships tm JOIN github_team_repo_permissions trp ON trp.team_id=tm.team_id AND trp.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE tm.revoked_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.account_id, NULL, c.permission_id, c.repository_id, c.permission, 'direct' FROM github_repo_collaborators c WHERE c.revoked_at IS NULL AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at>:snapshot_at)) x ON x.account_id=ga.account_id JOIN github_repositories r ON r.repository_id=x.repository_id WHERE p.person_id=:person_id ORDER BY r.name, x.permission_id

proposed_tools.name: get_current_drive_access_for_person
proposed_tools.description: Resolve current direct and nested-group Drive access for a person. Returns permission, membership, and resource IDs with classification.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Timestamp used to exclude expired permissions.

proposed_tools.sql: WITH RECURSIVE account_groups(account_id, group_id, membership_id, depth) AS (SELECT wa.account_id,m.group_id,m.membership_id,1 FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN workspace_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='account' AND m.member_id=wa.account_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE wa.person_id=:person_id UNION SELECT ag.account_id,m.group_id,m.membership_id,ag.depth+1 FROM account_groups ag JOIN workspace_group_memberships m ON m.member_type='group' AND m.member_id=ag.group_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ag.depth<10) SELECT wa.person_id, wa.account_id, dp.permission_id, NULL AS membership_id, dr.resource_id, dr.name AS resource_name, dr.classification, dp.role, dp.principal_type FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN drive_permissions dp ON dp.principal_type='account' AND dp.principal_id=wa.account_id JOIN drive_resources dr ON dr.resource_id=dp.resource_id WHERE wa.person_id=:person_id AND dp.revoked_at IS NULL AND (dp.expires_at IS NULL OR dp.expires_at>:snapshot_at) UNION ALL SELECT wa.person_id, wa.account_id, dp.permission_id, ag.membership_id, dr.resource_id, dr.name, dr.classification, dp.role, dp.principal_type FROM workspace_accounts wa JOIN account_groups ag ON ag.account_id=wa.account_id JOIN drive_permissions dp ON dp.principal_type='group' AND dp.principal_id=ag.group_id JOIN drive_resources dr ON dr.resource_id=dp.resource_id WHERE wa.person_id=:person_id AND dp.revoked_at IS NULL AND (dp.expires_at IS NULL OR dp.expires_at>:snapshot_at)

proposed_tools.name: get_unretired_devices_for_person
proposed_tools.description: Return all unretired devices linked to a person, including ownership, compliance, and last check-in details.
proposed_tools.sql: SELECT p.person_id, p.end_date, d.device_id, d.platform, d.ownership, d.compliance_status, d.enrolled_at, d.last_check_in_at, d.retired_at FROM people p JOIN devices d ON d.person_id=p.person_id WHERE p.person_id=:person_id AND d.retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.device_id
